lyrics.original:
सुन्दर सुन्दर विनायक
शुभ मंगल दायक विनायक
विघ्न कोटि हर विमल गजानन
सकल विघ्न हर साई गजानन
ईश्वरी नन्दन पार्थी गजानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Sundara Sundara Vinayaka
Shubha Mangala Dayaka Vinayaka
Vighna Koti Hara Vimala Gajanana
Sakala Vighna Hara Sai Gajanana
Eshwari Nandana Parthi Gajanana
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Ganesha who is very beautiful, who bestows everything good and auspicious. He is the remover of millions of obstacles that come in our way. He is the elephant-faced son of Parvathi and is verily Lord Sai who resides in Parthi.

lyrics.original:
दशरथ नन्दन राम दया सागर राम
रघुकुल तिलक राम सत्य साई श्री परन्धाम
अहल्योद्धारक राम शाप विमोचन राम
शिर्डी पुरीश राम पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परन्धाम
lyrics.transliteration:
Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama
Ahalyodharaka Rama Shaapa Vimochana Rama
Shirdi Pureesha Rama Puttaparthi Puri Parandhama
lyrics.translation: Glory to Thee, O Lord Rama, the darling son of King Dasharatha, You are an ocean of compassion and the Crown Jewel of the Raghu Dynasty. You are the saviour of Ahalya from the curse that had turned her into a stone. You are Lord Sathya Sai, the indweller of hearts, with Shirdi and Parthi as Your supreme abodes.

lines.original: दशरथ नन्दन राम दया सागर राम
lines.transliteration: Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama

lines.original: रघुकुल तिलक राम सत्य साई श्री परन्धाम
lines.transliteration: Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama

lines.original: शिर्डी पुरीश राम पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परन्धाम
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Pureesha Rama Puttaparthi Puri Parandhama

lyrics.original:
सत्य साई पदाम्बुजम् भजोरे मनसा निरन्तरम्
परम पवित्रम् पावन चरणम्
कलिमल दहनम् श्री गुरु चरणम्
भव भय नाशन दुरित निवारण
पार्थी पुरीश्वर पंकज चरणम्
lyrics.transliteration:
Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajorey Manasa Nirantharam
Parama Pavitram Pavana Charanam
Kalimala Dahanam Sri Guru Charanam
Bhava Bhaya Nashana Duritha Nivarana
Parthi Pureeshwara Pankaja Charanam
lyrics.translation: Meditate incessantly upon the most holy and auspicious Lotus Feet of Lord Sathya Sai. His feet are supremely pure and sacred. They burn away the sins of this Kali age. They destroy the fear of worldly existence and remove all afflictions. Worship the lotus feet of the Lord of Parthi.

lines.original: सत्य साई पदाम्बुजम् भजोरे मनसा निरन्तरम्
lines.transliteration: Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajorey Manasa Nirantharam

lyrics.original:
कोटि प्रणाम शत कोटि प्रणाम
हे दीन नाथ साई राम
तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार
तुम हो आनन्द नन्द के लाल
पार्थी पुरी के साई गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Koti Pranam Shata Koti Pranam
Hey Deena Natha Sai Ram
Tum Ho Bhakthon Ke Yuga Avatar
Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal
Parthi Puri Ke Sai Gopal
lyrics.translation: Many repeated salutations to You Lord Sai, the refuge of the forlorn. You are the incarnation of our age, born for the devotees. You are the son of Nanda, the blissful one. You are Sai Gopala residing at Parthi.

lines.original: तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Bhakthon Ke Yuga Avatar

lines.original: तुम हो आनन्द नन्द के लाल
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal

lyrics.original:
मनसा भजोरे गुरु चरणम्
दुस्तर भव सागर तरणम्
गुरु महाराज गुरु जय जय
साई नाथ गुरु जय जय
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय
अरुणाचल शिव अरुणाचल शिव
lyrics.transliteration:
Manasa Bhajorey Guru Charanam
Dusthara Bhava Sagara Tharanam
Guru Maharaj Guru Jai Jai
Sai Natha Guru Jai Jai
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva
lyrics.translation: O mind, worship at the feet of the Guru. Take refuge under His feet which enables us to cross the unconquerable ocean of life. Victory to the great Guru, victory to Lord Sai Natha. Chant Om Namah Shivaya, salutations to the Lord of Arunachala.

lines.original: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय
lines.transliteration: Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya

lyrics.original:
अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहारी साई जगत् जननी
माता माता माता जगत् जननी
जगत् जननी शुभ कारिणी
साई जगन्माता
सत्य साई जगन्माता
lyrics.transliteration:
Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani
Mata Mata Mata Jagat Janani
Jagat Janani Shubha Karini
Sai Jaganmata
Sathya Sai Jaganmata
lyrics.translation: Worship the auspicious Mother of the Universe, Mother Sai who has an enchanting face with a charming smile. She is the Mother of the world, the bestower of auspiciousness. Sathya Sai is the Mother of the entire creation.

lines.original: अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहारी साई जगत् जननी
lines.transliteration: Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani

lyrics.original:
पवन सुत हनुमान की जय
सीता पति रामचन्द्र की जय
पराक्रम अंजनेय की जय
पार्थी पुरी साई नाथ की जय
lyrics.transliteration:
Pavana Sutha Hanuman Ki Jai
Sita Pathi Ramachandra Ki Jai
Parakrama Anjaneya Ki Jai
Parthi Puri Sai Nath Ki Jai
lyrics.translation: Victory to Hanuman, the son of the wind God. Victory to the chosen Lord of Sita, Lord Ramachandra. Victory to the mighty son of Anjana Devi. Victory to the Lord of Parthi, Sai Nath.

lines.original: पार्थी पुरी साई नाथ की जय
lines.transliteration: Parthi Puri Sai Nath Ki Jai
